_comment: Pilot 1 measurements (BENCH_PLAN draft 6, bench/phase_r/make_cells.py docstring). kv_bytes_per_token: the disk tier's measured bytes per token; prefill_tok_s: micro batch 8 at 8,192 tokens; wt_offered_write_Bps: T's measured bytes per unique token x the load's workload unique tokens / its projected C0 makespan; RSS: pilot 1 peak beyond the CPU tier and the page cache (C0, T, T2, CT, PT about 5.2 to 6.9 GiB, K 7.2 to 7.4 GiB with the sidecar, LM 6.3 GiB beyond its L1) plus headroom; pilot 2 re-measures each.
